h1:
10 Hotels in Nan Town
An Old Town Among the Mountains
That We've Reviewed
heroSub: 10 stays in Nan town and the Phu Phiang side that we've reviewed in depth — old-town boutiques within walking distance of Wat Phumin and the walking street, teak bungalows with rice-field views, riverside guesthouses on the Nan River, and budget rooms. Prices from about ฿500–4,000/night.
heroStats: ✅ Honest takes from real reviews at every one
introH2: 🏯 What kinds of stays are there in Nan town, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Nan town is more compact than many people expect, and that's exactly why a stay's location matters so much on this trip — some are small boutiques in the old-town district where you open the door in the morning and see a temple wall, a few minutes' walk from Wat Phumin with its famous Pu Man Ya Man mural and the weekend walking street. Some are teak bungalows out in the rice fields on the Phu Phiang side, selling quiet and mountain views. And some are guesthouses on the Nan River where you can sit on the balcony watching the water all evening. · Plenty of people book on price alone and end up in a spot where they have to drive into town every time they want a meal or to visit a temple, until it starts to feel like wasted time. · This article gathers 10 stays in Nan town and on the Phu Phiang side that we've reviewed in depth — in the old town, by the river, and out in the fields — every one based on reading real guest reviews, with the upsides and the honest caveats, a 3-site price compare, and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Nan has no rapid transit, and it doesn't need one: the old-town district is compact enough to walk or cycle around easily, and several of the stays in this article lend out bikes for free. · From Nan Nakhon Airport (NNT) it's about a 10-minute drive into the old town. · The areas covered here: Old town (Nai Wiang sub-district) — walk to Wat Phumin, Wat Phaya Phu, the museum, and the walking street; ideal if you want to explore on foot. · Phu Phiang side (Muang Tuet, Fai Kaeo) — just across the Nan River bridge, rice-field and mountain views, near Wat Phra That Chae Haeng, quiet but you'll need a car to reach town. · Pha Sing, Du Tai (outskirts) — near the airport, quiet, easy on the wallet, good if you're driving yourself.

entries.type: 4-Star Rice-Field-View Boutique Resort · Phu Phiang Side
entries.name: Nan Seasons Boutique Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.1 · TripAdvisor 4.8/5 · 172 reviews · #1 in the district
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phu Phiang · near Wat Phra That Chae Haeng · about 10 min to the old town
tags: 🤝 Owners take you off the beaten path
entries.addr: 409 Moo 3, Ban Nong Tao, Muang Tuet sub-district, Phu Phiang district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: If you're going to start with the one stay reviewers in Nan agree on most, many give the nod to Nan Seasons Boutique Resort — a small boutique resort out in the rice fields of Phu Phiang district, across the Nan River from the old town. Drive over the bridge and it's about 10 minutes, near Wat Phra That Chae Haeng, the town's revered stupa. · What keeps it at #1 in the district on TripAdvisor, with a 4.8 out of 5 and a Travelers' Choice award, is the hands-on, "owners living alongside the guests" care from Dutch-Thai couple Rogier and Kas, who many reviews describe as warm and more helpful than expected — from suggesting places to visit to taking guests to the morning market, showing them woven textiles, and visiting villagers' farms. · The heart of the place is the Lanna-style teak bungalows spread through the garden, each with a private balcony where you can wake up, sip a coffee, and look out over the green fields and the line of mountains, quiet enough to hear only the birds. · There are two outdoor saltwater pools that suit both adults and kids, free bikes to ride through the fields, and the Lemongrass restaurant, whose freshly made à la carte breakfast many guests call a highlight. · Honest caveats from the reviews: the last stretch of road into the resort is a small lane through the village, so finding it the first time can be confusing after dark; being in the middle of the fields, there are naturally some mosquitoes and insects; some of the older wooden bungalows are starting to show their age, with dim lighting in spots; and there's no restaurant within walking distance, so you'll need a car. · It suits people coming to Nan to slow the pace down — who want quiet, a rice-field setting, and kind locals looking after them — more than the convenience of walking out for a meal.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Keep navigation open and call the resort if you can't find the way in after dark, and bring your own mosquito repellent since you're out in the fields. · And if you're set on activities like rafting or a cooking class, ask ahead whether they're running while you're there, since some are seasonal.
pros: TripAdvisor #1 in the district, 4.8/5, with a Travelers' Choice award
Warm, owner-run care that helps you experience Nan off the beaten path (from the reviews)
Teak bungalows with rice-field views, 2 pools, free bikes
Fresh à la carte breakfast that many reviews call a highlight
cons: The last stretch of road in is small; finding it the first time can be confusing after dark
Out in the fields with natural mosquitoes and insects; you need a car for town
Some of the older wooden bungalows are showing their age, dim lighting in spots (from reviews)

entries.type: 3-Star Garden-House Boutique · Foot of Khao Noi
entries.name: Casa Foresta Nan
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.1 · Booking 8.8 · garden house at the foot of Khao Noi
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Du Tai · near Wat Phra That Khao Noi
tags: ⛰️ Near Wat Phra That Khao Noi
entries.addr: 142 Moo 4, Ban Khao Noi, Du Tai sub-district, Mueang Nan district
entries.storyHtml: Casa Foresta Nan is a small garden-house boutique at the foot of Khao Noi in Du Tai sub-district, not far from Wat Phra That Khao Noi, Nan's popular viewpoint. Despite having only a handful of rooms, it scores a high 9.1 on Agoda. · Its appeal is that it feels like staying at the garden house of a friend with good taste — the rooms are separate cottages set among lush, shady trees, every one looking out onto the garden, so the atmosphere is quiet and very private, unlike a block hotel where rooms sit wall to wall. · Real reviews agree on the cleanliness, the care in the decor, and the quiet that suits anyone wanting a proper rest — many say they sleep soundly because there's no disturbance. · Being on the outskirts on the Du Tai side, it suits people driving themselves or renting a car; there's free parking on site, and it's a short drive into the old town — though you have to accept it isn't a spot where you walk out and find restaurants or cafés right away, the way a central stay would be. · Since it's small with only a few room types, Nan's high season (November–February, when the weather is cool and pleasant) and long weekends fill up fast, so book ahead. · Overall, Casa Foresta suits couples and travelers who value quiet, a garden-house feel, and privacy over being next to the sights, and who want a high-scoring stay at a price that's still within reach.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Since it's a garden house on the outskirts, having a car is easiest — drive up Khao Noi in the evening for sunset views over Nan town in just a few minutes. · And because there are only a few cottages, book ahead, especially in the cool season.
pros: Garden house surrounded by trees, quiet and very private
High 9.1 on Agoda · clean, carefully decorated rooms
Near Wat Phra That Khao Noi viewpoint · free parking
Suits couples and anyone wanting a proper rest at an affordable price
cons: On the outskirts on the Du Tai side; you need a car, nothing within walking distance
Small with only a few room types; fills fast in high season and on long weekends
Doesn't have the full range of facilities of a big hotel

entries.type: Rice-Field-View Resort · Phu Phiang Side · 21 Rooms
entries.name: Chomna Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phu Phiang · 1.5 km from town · on the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng road
tags: 🚲 On the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng road
entries.addr: 10 Moo 17, Fai Kaeo sub-district, Phu Phiang district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: Chomna Resort is the answer for anyone who wants Nan's rice-field setting but whose budget doesn't stretch to four figures, because here prices start at around ฿500 a night yet it scores a high 9.0 on both Trip.com and Agoda — a value ratio that isn't easy to find in the province. · The resort is in Phu Phiang district, Fai Kaeo sub-district, about 1.5 kilometers from Nan town on the road to Wat Phra That Chae Haeng, and not far from the airport, which makes it convenient for both fliers and drivers. · It's a set of compact wood-frame cabins, 21 rooms strung along a small lane through the grounds, many with a private balcony looking out over the green fields — a quiet, rural feel, perfect for waking early to birdsong and fresh air. · Real reviews praise the value above all, saying the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable, and the staff friendly for what you pay; many feel they got more than they expected for a stay in the few-hundred-baht range. · There are several room tiers to choose from, from Standard up to the roomier Family and Villa for families or groups of friends. · What to accept, as with any budget stay, is that the facilities are basic — no pool or full-service resort amenities — and it's on the Phu Phiang side, so you'll drive into town a little when you want food in the evening. · It suits budget travelers, families, and anyone who wants a rice-field setting on the lightest budget in this article.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The price is great value but the facilities are basic, so it works best as a base to sleep and head out all day. · Pick a room with a balcony over the fields for the best of the atmosphere, and since it's on the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng road, it's easy to stop and pay respects at the stupa before heading into town.
pros: Best value in the article: from just ฿500 yet 9.0 on both sites
Rice-field-view cabins, many with a private balcony
1.5 km from town on the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng road · near the airport
Room tiers up to Family and Villa for larger groups
cons: Basic facilities, no swimming pool
On the Phu Phiang side; you'll drive into town for food in the evening
It's a budget cabin stay, not a luxury resort

entries.type: 2-Star Loft Boutique · Wat Phra That Chae Haeng Area
entries.name: Pagoda Sight Residence
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.0 · Booking 8.9 · stupa and rice-field views
entries.badge: 🛕 Wat Phra That Chae Haeng views
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phu Phiang · Wat Phra That Chae Haeng area · field and mountain views
tags: 🛕 Views of the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng stupa
entries.addr: 441 Moo 3, Muang Tuet sub-district, Phu Phiang district, Nan (Wat Phra That Chae Haeng area)
entries.storyHtml: Pagoda Sight Residence is named for a view that's a genuine selling point — the property is in the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng area of Phu Phiang district, and from many angles you can see the stupa of Nan's town temple, with green rice fields and a line of mountains behind the property, an atmosphere that's both calm and tied to local culture. · It's a small loft boutique, owner-run, scoring 9.0 on Agoda and 8.9 on Booking, which is high for a stay in this price range. · The rooms are decorated in a modern, air-conditioned loft style, clean and compact, with several types to choose from — from a single-bed room up to the Deluxe with a private balcony where you can catch the cool breeze over the fields, and a two-bedroom Family Suite. · Real reviews praise the view, the cleanliness, and the owner's friendly, helpful care; many love the morning atmosphere of fresh air and a view of the stupa from the property. · Being on the Phu Phiang side in the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng area, it suits people who specifically come to pay respects at the stupa and want to stay nearby, or who prefer a rice-field setting over the bustle of the center — though you'll need a car for the roughly 10-minute drive into the old town when you want the walking street or a restaurant. · It's a small stay, so the facilities are just-enough rather than a full-service resort. · Overall it suits couples, small families, and anyone who wants stupa and rice-field views at an accessible price, with the care of an owner-run place.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the view matters to you, pick the Deluxe with the private balcony over the fields and stupa. · Get up early and walk to nearby Wat Phra That Chae Haeng for a great atmosphere, and keep the car for trips into the old town.
pros: Views of the Wat Phra That Chae Haeng stupa and rice fields, a calm setting
9.0 on Agoda · friendly, owner-run care
Clean loft-style rooms, with a two-bedroom Family Suite
Accessible price, near Wat Phra That Chae Haeng
cons: On the Phu Phiang side; you need a car for the roughly 10-minute drive into the old town
Small stay, just-enough facilities, not a full-service resort
No restaurants or cafés within walking distance in the area

entries.type: 3-Star Boutique Guesthouse · Pha Sing, Near the Airport
entries.name: Muen Chang Nan Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.9 · Booking 8.9 · family guesthouse near the airport
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pha Sing · about 1.4 km from Nan Airport
entries.addr: 295 Moo 6, Ban Udom Sap, Pha Sing sub-district, Mueang Nan district
entries.storyHtml: Muen Chang Nan Boutique Hotel is a small, family-run boutique guesthouse in Pha Sing sub-district whose clear strengths are value and a location near the airport. · The stay is only about 1.4 kilometers from Nan Nakhon Airport, which makes it a great fit for anyone arriving on a late flight or leaving early, with no need to build in a long transfer. · Prices start at around ฿500 a night yet it scores a high 8.9 on both Agoda and Booking, a sign that guests are happy beyond what they paid. · Because it's a family-run place, real reviews single out the friendliness of the owner and staff in particular — saying they give good advice, look after you attentively, and make it feel as warm as staying with relatives. · The stay is in a quiet area on the edge of town, a little away from the bustle, so you sleep well and it suits anyone wanting quiet. · There are several room types, from Standard Double up to a Family room, clean and with the essentials in guesthouse style. · What to accept is that, as a small budget stay, the facilities are basic — no pool or full hotel services — and the Pha Sing location means driving or calling a ride into the old town when you want temples or the walking street. · It suits budget travelers, families, and anyone needing a stay near the airport for the first or last night of a trip on a very light budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It works great as a first- or last-night stay because it's near the airport. · Since it's a small, family-run place, message the owner ahead about check-in times and airport pickup, and consider renting a car or motorbike for getting into town.
pros: Great value, from around ฿500 yet 8.9 on both Agoda and Booking
About 1.4 km from Nan Airport, ideal for the first/last night
Warm, friendly owner-run care (from the reviews)
Quiet area on the edge of town, easy to sleep
cons: Basic facilities, no swimming pool
Pha Sing location; you need a car or a ride into the old town
It's a small budget guesthouse, the rooms aren't luxurious

entries.type: Boutique Guesthouse · Heart of Nan Old Town
entries.name: NirvaNAN House
entries.revCount: Booking 8.8 · Agoda 8.9 · old-town boutique across from Wat Phaya Phu
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Trok Phaya Phu · 6-min walk to Wat Phumin
tags: 🚶 Walk to Wat Phumin and the walking street
entries.addr: 10 Trok Phaya Phu, Nai Wiang sub-district, Mueang Nan district
entries.storyHtml: If you're judging on an old-town location, NirvaNAN House is the stay many reviews give an almost perfect mark — a small boutique guesthouse of about 10 rooms tucked into Trok Phaya Phu in Nai Wiang sub-district, right in the heart of Nan's old town. · What makes people fall for it: open the door in the morning and the wall of Wat Phaya Phu is right across the street, with Wat Phumin about a 6-minute walk away — home to the famous Pu Man Ya Man "whispering of love" mural — and Nan's weekend walking street just a few blocks off, so you can explore the whole district on foot without a car. · Open since 2017, it has the quiet feel of a private home more than a hotel: warm-toned boutique rooms, clean, many looking onto the garden or pool, with the rooms guests favor being those with a private balcony for a morning coffee. · Small as it is, it still has an outdoor garden pool, free bikes, and free parking, while breakfast is a much-praised point — well chosen, freshly made, with American, Thai, or Asian styles to pick from. · The attentive, personal service from the owner and team makes many feel like a guest in someone's home. · The honest caveat reviews mention most is the price — for a stay in Nan, NirvaNAN House sits fairly high, from around ฿4,000, which is pricier than most stays in town, and with few rooms it fills fast and doesn't have the full range of facilities of a big hotel. · It suits couples and travelers who value an old-town location within walking distance of everything, and a quiet, private atmosphere, over the nightly price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With only about 10 rooms, it fills very fast in high season (Nov–Feb) and during festivals, so book several weeks ahead. · If you want a room with a balcony, specify it at booking, and use the free bikes to explore the old town rather than driving — it's far easier.
pros: Best old-town location in the article: walk to Wat Phumin, Wat Phaya Phu, and the walking street
Quiet, private, home-like atmosphere with attentive service
Well-chosen breakfast with styles to pick from, praised in many reviews
Garden pool, free bikes, and free parking
cons: Fairly high price for Nan, from around ฿4,000
Few rooms, about 10, fills fast in high season
Doesn't have the full range of facilities of a big hotel

entries.name: Nan Boutique Hotel
entries.badge: 🚶 Central, walk to temples and the market
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · on Khuang Luang Road · walk to temples and the market
tags: 🚶 Walk to temples and the market
entries.addr: 1/11 Khuang Luang Road, Nai Wiang sub-district, Mueang Nan district
entries.storyHtml: Nan Boutique Hotel is a central Nan boutique that sells the ease of exploring on foot, set on Khuang Luang Road in Nai Wiang sub-district, in a part of town where you can walk to major temples, restaurants, and the market in just a few minutes. · It's a mid-range pick starting at around ฿1,200 a night, scoring 8.6 on Booking and 8.5 on Agoda — good for anyone who wants to stay central on a sensible budget, not as high as a premium boutique but in a good location. · Its charm is the warm, distinctive vintage decor — not the identical-looking rooms of a chain hotel; many reviews praise clean rooms, a lovely atmosphere, and pretty photo corners. · It also lends out free bikes for cycling around the old town, which suits compact Nan, with no need to call a ride. · Real reviews are positive overall, praising the easy-to-get-around location, the value, and the helpful staff. · The honest caveats: as a boutique building in town, some room types aren't very large and some spots are starting to show wear, and being a central location, some rooms may get a bit of outside noise. · Overall, Nan Boutique Hotel suits travelers and families who want a central stay within walking distance of the sights at an accessible price, with a lovely vintage atmosphere, without paying premium-boutique rates.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The central location is walkable, so use the free bikes to ride to the temples and market instead of driving. · If you're a light sleeper, ask for a room not facing the main road to avoid outside noise on some nights.
pros: Central, on Khuang Luang Road, walk to temples and the market
Accessible mid-range price, from around ฿1,200 · Deluxe Family available
Warm, distinctive vintage decor, clean rooms
Free bikes for exploring the old town
cons: Some room types aren't very large, and some spots are starting to show wear
Central location; some rooms may get outside noise
No pool or resort-style facilities

entries.name: Nantrungjai Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: Booking 8.4 · Agoda 8.3 · 4★ boutique with a big garden, near the airport
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nan–Tha Wang Pha Rd · 5 min from the airport
entries.addr: 354 Moo 2, Nan–Tha Wang Pha Road, Pha Sing sub-district, Mueang Nan district
entries.storyHtml: Nantrungjai Boutique Hotel is a 4-star boutique hotel on Nan–Tha Wang Pha Road in Pha Sing sub-district, with a big shady garden, a pool, and a location only about 5 minutes from Nan Airport as its strengths. · It suits people who want a 4-star hotel with common areas and a pool but don't want to pay a premium, with prices from around ฿1,800 a night, scoring 8.4 on Booking and 8.3 on Agoda. · The hotel sits on a large plot with a garden, so the feel is open and quieter than a central stay, with easy parking for drivers and the convenience of being near the airport for fliers. · There are several room tiers, from Boutique Room up to Junior Suite and a Family room for families or groups, covering many kinds of trip. · Real reviews praise the pretty garden, the pool, and the value of a 4-star at this price, along with helpful staff. · The honest caveats: the Pha Sing location is outside the old town, not a spot where you walk out to temples or the walking street, so you'll drive or call a ride into town for about 5–10 minutes when you want to go out or find a restaurant, and having been open for a while, some spots may be starting to show their age. · Overall it suits families and self-drivers who want a 4-star stay with a pool and a garden at a good price, plus the convenience of getting to and from the airport.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It suits self-drivers thanks to easy parking and being near the airport. · If you're with family, look at the roomier Junior Suite or Family, and allow 5–10 minutes to drive into the old town for the temples.
pros: 4-star boutique with a pool and big garden at a good price, from around ฿1,800
About 5 minutes from Nan Airport, convenient for fliers
Easy parking, an open feel quieter than the center
Several room tiers up to Junior Suite and Family
cons: Pha Sing location outside the old town; you need a car for the 5–10-minute trip into town
Not within walking distance of temples or the walking street
Open for a while; some spots are starting to show their age (from reviews)

entries.name: Pround Nan Cottage
entries.revCount: Booking 8.4 · Agoda 8.3 · quiet garden cottages, owner-run
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pha Sing · outskirts · 3.7 km from the airport
entries.addr: 39 Moo 5, Pha Sing sub-district, Mueang Nan district
entries.storyHtml: Pround Nan Cottage is a garden-cottage stay on the outskirts of Nan in Pha Sing sub-district, selling a quiet atmosphere and family-run care. · The stay is cottages that blend a wooden-house feel with modern comfort, set in shady garden grounds, so it feels as relaxing as staying at a garden house rather than a hotel. · Prices start at around ฿1,000 a night, scoring 8.4 on Booking and 8.3 on Agoda — good for anyone who wants a quiet stay on an easy budget. · What real reviews praise most is the friendly, attentive care of the hosts, like family; many say they felt warmly looked after and got good tips on places to visit. · There are free bikes for cycling around and common areas to sit and enjoy the garden, which suits a family stay since it accommodates all ages, with rooms from Standard up to Family and VIP for those who want more space. · The honest caveat is that the Pha Sing location is on the outskirts, about 3.7 kilometers from the old town and the airport, so you'll drive or call a ride into town when you want temples or the walking street, and being a small stay, the facilities are just-enough — no pool or full hotel services. · Overall it suits families and couples who want a quiet garden-house atmosphere, owner-run care, and a light price in the low four figures.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's great for a family stay thanks to the roomy Family and VIP rooms. · Use the free bikes to ride around, and keep the car for trips into town, since the outskirts location means a car is easiest.
pros: Quiet garden cottages, a relaxing garden-house atmosphere
Light price from around ฿1,000 · Family and VIP rooms available
Friendly, attentive owner-run care (from the reviews)
Free bikes and common areas to enjoy the garden
cons: Pha Sing outskirts location, about 3.7 km from the old town; you need a car
Just-enough facilities, no swimming pool
Not within walking distance of temples or restaurants in town

entries.type: Boutique Guesthouse on the Nan River · Central
entries.name: NanRimnam (Nan Riverside)
entries.revCount: Booking 8.4 · Agoda 8.3 · 5-room guesthouse on the Nan River
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · on the Nan River · walk to the walking street
entries.addr: 190/1 Mano Road, Nai Wiang sub-district, Mueang Nan district
entries.storyHtml: Closing with a stay that sells a different atmosphere from the others in this article — NanRimnam (Nan Riverside) is a small boutique guesthouse of about 5 rooms on the Nan River, on Mano Road in Nai Wiang sub-district, in town. · The Nan River is the main waterway that has nourished this town for ages, so staying riverside gives you a closeness to Nan's way of life that a stay among buildings can't. · Its strength is the simple but charming Lanna decor, with a northern cultural touch, and rooms with a balcony where you can sit and watch the slow current all evening. · As a small stay in town, you can walk to the walking street and restaurants, so you get both riverside calm and the convenience of exploring on foot. · Real reviews praise the river view, the quiet atmosphere, and the lovely, distinctive decor. · The honest caveat is that prices start at around ฿2,500 a night, which is fairly high for a small guesthouse in Nan, and with only about 5 rooms it fills very fast, especially in high season and on holidays, so book far ahead; it's also a small stay without the full range of hotel facilities. · Overall, NanRimnam suits couples and travelers who value a riverside Lanna atmosphere and the privacy of a small stay over the number of facilities or the nightly price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want the river view, go straight for the Deluxe River View and specify it at booking, since there are very few rooms. · It's a small guesthouse of about 5 rooms that fills fast, so book far ahead in high season and on holidays.
pros: On the Nan River, a quiet, distinctive Lanna atmosphere
Rooms with a balcony over the water · walk to the walking street in town
Small and very private, lovely decor (from the reviews)
Both riverside calm and the convenience of exploring on foot
cons: Prices from around ฿2,500, fairly high for a small guesthouse in Nan
Only about 5 rooms, fills very fast, book far ahead
Doesn't have the full range of hotel facilities

adviceTitle: How to pick a stay in Nan town that fits your trip

advice.head: Want to sleep in the old town and walk to temples and the walking street
advice.bodyHtml: → NirvaNAN House ฿4,000, across from Wat Phaya Phu, walk to Wat Phumin · or Nan Boutique Hotel ฿1,200, central at a lighter price

advice.head: Want a rice-field setting, quiet on the Phu Phiang side
advice.bodyHtml: → Nan Seasons Boutique Resort ฿2,000, teak bungalows with field views, owner-run · or Pagoda Sight Residence ฿1,200, stupa and rice-field views

advice.head: Tightest budget but still a good score
advice.bodyHtml: → Chomna Resort or Muen Chang Nan Boutique Hotel, both from around ฿500, scoring 8.9–9.0

advice.head: Want to stay on the Nan River, a Lanna atmosphere
advice.bodyHtml: → NanRimnam (Nan Riverside) ฿2,500, a riverside Lanna-style guesthouse, rooms with a balcony over the water, walk to the walking street

advice.head: Want a garden house, quiet and private, high score
advice.bodyHtml: → Casa Foresta Nan ฿1,500, a garden house at the foot of Khao Noi, 9.1 on Agoda, near Wat Phra That Khao Noi

advice.head: Stay near the airport, first or last night
advice.bodyHtml: → Muen Chang Nan Boutique Hotel ฿500, 1.4 km from the airport · or Nantrungjai Boutique Hotel ฿1,800, a 4-star boutique with a pool near the airport

advice.head: Traveling as a family or a group of friends
advice.bodyHtml: → Nantrungjai has Junior Suite/Family · Pround Nan Cottage has Family/VIP · Chomna Resort has a Villa — all accommodate groups at a good price

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room range and may change by date and season; we recommend checking the real price and comparing all 3 sites before every booking. · The scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on the booking platforms, not from staying ourselves. · Several stays are on the Phu Phiang side or the outskirts (Pha Sing, Du Tai), which require a car into the old town, while the central stays let you walk to temples and the walking street. · In Nan's high season (November–February, when the weather is cool and pleasant) and on long weekends, stays fill fast, especially the small ones with few rooms, so book ahead. · Nan has no rapid transit; the old-town district is compact enough to walk or cycle around, and it's about a 10-minute drive from the airport into town. · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — Common questions travelers ask about stays in Nan town

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best stay in Nan town?
faq.a: It depends on your trip's style. · If you judge on score and care, Nan Seasons Boutique Resort holds #1 in the district on TripAdvisor at 4.8/5 with a Travelers' Choice, teak bungalows with field views, owner-run. · If you want an old-town location within walking distance of temples and the walking street, NirvaNAN House. · For best value, Chomna Resort and Muen Chang Nan from around ฿500. · For a high-scoring garden house, Casa Foresta Nan.

faq.q: ❓ How much do stays in Nan town cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start from about ฿500–4,000 per night. · On the budget side are Chomna Resort and Muen Chang Nan from around ฿500, and Pround Nan Cottage from ฿1,000. · Mid-range are Nan Boutique Hotel and Pagoda Sight at ฿1,200, Casa Foresta at ฿1,500, Nantrungjai at ฿1,800, and Nan Seasons at ฿2,000. · At the top are NanRimnam at ฿2,500 and NirvaNAN House at ฿4,000. · All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard room; during festivals they may run higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay in Nan — can you walk around or do you need a car?
faq.a: The old town (Nai Wiang sub-district) lets you walk to Wat Phumin, Wat Phaya Phu, and the walking street, ideal if you don't have a car (NirvaNAN House, Nan Boutique Hotel, NanRimnam). · The Phu Phiang side has rice-field and mountain views, near Wat Phra That Chae Haeng, quiet but you need a car (Nan Seasons, Chomna Resort, Pagoda Sight). · Pha Sing/Du Tai (outskirts) is near the airport, easy on the wallet, good if you're driving yourself (Muen Chang Nan, Nantrungjai, Pround Nan Cottage, Casa Foresta).

faq.q: ❓ Which stay in Nan town is good for couples?
faq.a: Several stays in the article lean into a quiet atmosphere that suits couples. · Strong picks: NirvaNAN House, an old-town boutique across from Wat Phaya Phu with a romantic atmosphere · Nan Seasons Boutique Resort, quiet, private teak bungalows with field views · and NanRimnam, a riverside Lanna-style guesthouse with rooms with a balcony over the water.

faq.q: ❓ Which stay in Nan town suits a family or a large group?
faq.a: Pick ones with a family room or a villa. · Nantrungjai Boutique Hotel has Junior Suite and Family rooms plus a pool and a big garden · Pround Nan Cottage has Family and VIP rooms with a garden-house feel · Chomna Resort has a Villa at a light price · and Nan Seasons has a two-bedroom Family Villa, good for groups who want a rice-field setting.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a stay in Nan?
faq.a: Several stays in this article are small boutiques and guesthouses (some with just 5–10 rooms), so they fill fast. · During Nan's high season (November–February, when the weather is cool and pleasant) and on long weekends, book several weeks to 1–2 months ahead, especially NirvaNAN House and NanRimnam, which have very few rooms. · At other times, 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. · Every platform usually offers Free Cancellation, so it's worth locking in that kind of rate if your plans aren't firm, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price.
